We have mass spec data: m/z 194.0862 (intensity 100) etc. Likely molecular ion at 194.0862. Need to deduce formula. We have candidate formulas from isomer search: C9H19ClO2 (calc mass?) Let's compute exact mass: C9H19ClO2: C 12.0000*9=108, H 1.007825*19=19.1487, Cl 34.96885, O2 31.98983 => total 108+19.1487+34.9689+31.9898=194.1074 approx. Slightly higher than 194.0862. Let's compute C8H15ClO3: C8=96, H15=15.1174, Cl=34.9689, O3=47.9847 => total 193. (96+15.1174+34.9689+47.9847)=194.0710. That's close to 194.0862 (difference 0.015). Could be C8H15ClO3. Another possibility C7H11ClO4: C7=84, H11=11.086, Cl=34.969, O4=63.9797 => total 193. (84+11.086+34.969+63.9797)=193. (actually 193. +?) compute: 84+11.086=95.086, +34.969=130.055, +63.9797=194.0347. Slightly lower. So C8H15ClO3 seems plausible.
